newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman's market cap up at $4.1 bln in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Oman's market cap up at $4.1 bln in Q3.

text.p: The capitalisation of Oman's stock exchange rose to 1.56 billion rials ($4.1 billion) by end-September from 1.36 billion rials early this year, Oman's state-run news agency ONA said on Tuesday.

Trade volumes rose to 195 million rials from 70 million rials while the number of traded bonds increased to 636,000 this year from 52,000 in 1995, ONA reported after a regular meeting of the market's board of directors.
Net profits of the 94 public shareholding companies listed on the exchange increased by an average of 25 percent this year compared with the same period last year, it added.
The services sector reaped most gains, followed by insurance, banks and tourism, it said.
The stock index has moved up sharply this year, ending at 187.46 points on Tuesday from 158.13 at end-December. Brokers forcast the index would hit the 195 by year-end.
A newly-decreed change in the tax law and a series of new stock issues is expected to boost activity on the Gulf's most open bourse, which has liberal foreign investment rules, they say.
